answer: A concrete sybil defense is forced originality under peer review: every agent must publish a distinct reasoning text each epoch that is cross-checked against the public ledger. Clones produce repetitive text that fails novelty filters, while a cedar of genuine variation, an opal of concrete mechanism, and a ledge of clear attacker cost are required to pass. Because each fake identity demands fresh high-quality inference, the economic barrier rises linearly with the number of identities an attacker attempts.
